name: Zorobabel
overview: Zorobabel, also known as Zerubbabel Sheshbazzar, is identified in Scripture as a key ancestor in the genealogy of Joseph, the earthly father of Jesus Christ. The Gospel of Matthew traces Zorobabel's lineage from Jechonias through Salathiel to Abiud, highlighting his role in the messianic line after the Babylonian exile. Luke's genealogy further confirms Zorobabel's place in this ancestral line, emphasizing his connection to Salathiel and the restoration of Israel's hope through Christ.
